name: Void Cat Appreciator Society
source:
Did you know that black cats are the least likely to be adopted from the shelter?  We here at the Void Cat Appreciator Society will not stand for it!  It is our mission to make black cats look as adorable as possible for their adoption photos and help every black cat find a forever home.

[From [url=https://cloverfirefly.itch.io/void-cat-appreciator-society]itch.io[/url]]
